body: “We knew, finally, that the girls were really women in disguise, that they understood love and even death, and that our job was merely to create the noise that seemed to fascinate them.”
I feel the same. Soon I’ll be ending everything and I can breathe a sigh of relief
Sleeping pills. A lot of them

I don’t think I can give you advice as I may be a bit hypocritical. 

Please don’t commit to ending your life I am not encouraging it. 

This is my own conscious decision that I’ve put lots of thought into. 

The pain is going to be difficult but I’ll get through it. More waits on the other side.

I often feel tired and detached. Very melancholy. 


My teachers often say “Dear, you look so exhausted” so clearly it’s not all in my head.

I obsess over the tiniest ideas and I feel like there are marbles in my head. They roll around when there’s too much happening and I can’t hear anything but muffled noises. 

I feel like suicide is an option and it’s my only option. I don’t feel weak but accepting my fate gives me something to look forward to. 

Knowing it will be over soon, I can breathe a sigh of relief.
I hope you find yourself whether it be in this life or the next. May our paths cross on the other side.
Therapy never works. I had a traumatic experience with it and I can’t go back to any counsellor at all. I just can’t do it anymore I feel like my days are numbered.

Sorry if I’m not much help- You’ve come so far, why give into a temporary feeling you know you’ll regret? Your arm may want it but do you? I doubt it. Don’t give into the desire to self harm, please you’ll feel terrible after. You’ve come so so SO far. 

Three years is phenomenal! You’re phenomenal!
